items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: I contacted Wilbur, and we played the Monday and Tuesdays.

ctx.x: And this was such a surprise --and a joyful one for me, and at the time, Jody was in the audience.

Yes. He had just got his discharge from the service, so he comes and he says, "Who do you have on the piano, Wilbur?" And I said, "Jodie, you can have it." And I was thinking in the back of my mind that we could make it. So I started that month ... so I would go on Monday and Tuesdays down there, but that was (unintelligible) and George and Brownie ... Brownie said, "Man, I like your playing; come on by the hotel." Well, naturally George Morrow and I hung out -- bass players, and I contacted Wilbur, and we played…
